canonical_example.text: Practicar contrabando está penado con varios años de cárcel.
canonical_example.translation: Engaging in smuggling is punishable by several years' imprisonment.

canonical_example.text: La policía del aeropuerto halló contrabando en la maleta del detenido.
canonical_example.translation: The airport police found contraband in the arrested man's suitcase.

canonical_example.text: Los guardias no se explican cómo pudo llegar el contrabando a la celda del prisionero.
canonical_example.translation: Prison guards can't explain how the smuggled goods got into the prisoner's cell.

canonical_example.text: Le mandaron que no se moviera ni hiciera nada.
canonical_example.translation: He was ordered to stay still and do nothing.

canonical_example.text: El profesor mandó a los alumnos estar callados mientras hacían el examen.
canonical_example.translation: The teacher told the students to be quiet during the exam.

canonical_example.text: El policía le mandó que se detuviera.
canonical_example.translation: The policeman commanded him to stop.

canonical_example.text: ¿Debería mandarle flores para su cumpleaños?
canonical_example.translation: Should I send her flowers for her birthday?

canonical_example.text: Mi mamá me mandó a la panadería a comprar una barra de pan.
canonical_example.translation: My mom sent me to the bakery to buy a loaf of bread.

canonical_example.text: El gerente manda en el departamento de ventas de la compañía.
canonical_example.translation: The manager is in charge of the sales department of the company.

canonical_example.translation: During World War II, my grandfather was in command of the parachute corps.

canonical_example.text: ¿Quién manda el coro de niños que cantó en el festival?
canonical_example.translation: Who is in charge of the children's choir that sang at the festival?

canonical_example.text: La abuela me mandó a venir a pasar la tarde con ella.
canonical_example.translation: Grandma sent for me to come and spend the afternoon with her.

canonical_example.text: El médico le mandó una pastilla para su dolor de cabeza.
canonical_example.translation: The doctor prescribed a pill for his headache.

canonical_example.text: El portero mandó el balón al delantero de su equipo.
canonical_example.translation: The goalkeeper sent the ball to his team's center-forward.

canonical_example.text: El jugador de tenis mandó la pelota directamente al cuerpo de su adversario.
canonical_example.translation: The tennis player hit the ball right to his opponent.

canonical_example.translation: She threw her wedding ring into the sea after getting divorced.

canonical_example.text: Él manda hasta que el capitán lo releve.
canonical_example.translation: He is in command until he is relieved by the Captain.

canonical_example.text: Mi hermano siempre se manda cada excusa para no hacer los deberes.
canonical_example.translation: My brother always comes out with great excuses to not do his homework.

canonical_example.text: Se empachó después de haberse mandado toda la torta.
canonical_example.translation: He got an upset stomach after polishing off the whole cake.

canonical_example.text: La salsa estaba tan picosa que se mandó toda la jarra de cerveza.
canonical_example.translation: The salsa was so hot that he knocked back the whole pitcher of beer.

canonical_example.text: Sergio estaba tan nervioso antes de la cita que se mandó un whisky.
canonical_example.translation: Sergio was so nervous before the meeting that he downed a whiskey.

canonical_example.text: Ese primo tuyo se manda con nosotros.
canonical_example.translation: That cousin of yours takes advantage of us.

canonical_example.text: Dile que se mande cambiar.
canonical_example.translation: Tell him to clear off.

canonical_example.translation: I feel more alert in the morning than at night.

canonical_example.translation: The most effective way to bring down a fever is taking a cool bath.

canonical_example.translation: His fever won't go down without medication.

canonical_example.translation: Exports have dropped due to the stock market crash.

canonical_example.translation: Get off at the next station, and you are downtown.

canonical_example.translation: Get out as soon as I stop at the lights.

canonical_example.text: ¿Me bajarías ese libro de la estantería?
canonical_example.translation: Would you take that book down from the shelf for me?

canonical_example.translation: We have to lower our expenses to save for the wedding.

canonical_example.translation: If they don't turn the music down, we'll go to another bar.

canonical_example.translation: You are committing a crime when you download movies illegally.

canonical_example.translation: I get off at the next stop.

canonical_example.translation: Be careful when you get out of the sportscar.

canonical_example.translation: I have an appointment with the orthopedist because when I bend down, my knees hurt.

canonical_example.translation: Mozart's music has a very good balance between the rhythm, the harmony, and the melody.

canonical_example.text: Debemos fomentar el respeto y la armonía entre nuestros compañeros de trabajo, aun cuando pensemos diferente.
canonical_example.translation: We should foster respect and harmony among our coworkers, even if we have different views.

canonical_example.text: Aunque la casa está pintada de varios colores, están combinados en perfecta armonía.
canonical_example.translation: Although the house is painted in several colors, they are combined in perfect harmony.

canonical_example.text: La carretera que te lleva a la montaña está cerrada.
canonical_example.translation: The road that takes you to the mountains is closed.

canonical_example.text: El límite de velocidad en la carretera es de 110 mi/h.
canonical_example.translation: The speed limit on the highway is 110 mph.

canonical_example.text: El carretero utiliza materiales muy resistentes para sus carretas.
canonical_example.translation: The cartwright uses very solid materials for the carts he makes.

canonical_example.text: El carretero dirigió a los bueyes hacia la entrada del establo.
canonical_example.translation: The cart driver led the oxen towards the entrace of the stable.

canonical_example.text: Manuel es un auténtico carretero y yo solo invitaré a mis fiestas a gente que sepa comportarse.
canonical_example.translation: Manuel is a real boor and I will only invite people who can behave themselves to my parties.

canonical_example.translation: The man who was driving the car found himself involved in a dramatic road accident.

canonical_example.text: Me duelen los riñones de estar tanto tiempo de pie.
canonical_example.translation: My lower back is aching from being on my feet so long.

canonical_example.translation: My grandfather had kidney surgery last week.

canonical_example.text: Tras una reunión de dos horas, llegamos por fin al riñón del asunto.
canonical_example.translation: After a two-hour meeting, we finally came to the heart of the matter.

canonical_example.text: Para mí, los riñones al vino blanco.
canonical_example.translation: I'll have the kidneys in white wine.

canonical_example.text: El nuevo senador fue elegido por una aplastante mayoría.
canonical_example.translation: The new senator was elected with an overwhelming majority.

canonical_example.translation: Marcos looked at his digital watch and said, "It's four o'clock sharp."

canonical_example.translation: The detectives found fingerprints on the knife.

canonical_example.translation: The foxgloves in the garden have tubular, purple flowers.

canonical_example.translation: I want an ornamental plants on the balcony. Maybe a digitalis or a petunia.

canonical_example.text: Tiene un acento británico encantador.
canonical_example.translation: She has a lovely British accent.

canonical_example.translation: A British person can spend a lot of money on tea.

canonical_example.text: El objetivo de minar una montaña es crear galerías para buscar metales.
canonical_example.translation: The aim of mining a mountain is to create galleries to search for ore.

canonical_example.translation: The measures implemented by the ministry of education are undermining the morale of teachers.

canonical_example.text: La enfermedad mina las defensas naturales del cuerpo.
canonical_example.translation: The disease damages the body's natural defenses.

canonical_example.text: Los rebeldes minaron gran parte de los caminos de acceso al territorio bajo su control.
canonical_example.translation: The rebels have mined many of the approach roads to the territory they control.

canonical_example.text: Usa alcohol puro para borrar el marcador permanente.
canonical_example.translation: Use pure alcohol to remove permanent marker.

canonical_example.text: ¿Dijo que yo le robé dinero? Son puras mentiras.
canonical_example.translation: He said I stole his money? That's just lies.

canonical_example.text: Mi padre siempre fuma puros habanos cuando juega al póquer.
canonical_example.translation: My father always smokes Cuban cigars when he is playing poker.

canonical_example.text: Este anillo de oro puro cuesta un medio millón de dólares.

canonical_example.text: Necesito irme de la ciudad para respirar aire puro.
canonical_example.translation: I need to leave the city to breathe clean air.

canonical_example.text: Encontré la billetera que perdiste de pura casualidad.
canonical_example.translation: I've found the wallet you lost by pure chance.

canonical_example.translation: She screamed at everyone in the room out of sheer rage.

canonical_example.translation: He says he will only get married to a woman who is pure.

canonical_example.translation: The priest believes only chaste men and women can experience true love.

canonical_example.text: Mi amigo de Ghana cree que en los Estados Unidos hay puros ricos.
canonical_example.translation: My friend from Ghana believes that there are only rich people in the United States.

canonical_example.translation: They threw the book at me for smoking in the bathroom.

canonical_example.translation: For the equation test, please follow the steps to eliminate the variable.

canonical_example.translation: Several developing countries have created effective models to get rid of illiteracy.

canonical_example.translation: Drinking hot water with lemon helps you eliminate toxins.

canonical_example.translation: We had a long list of candidates, but many were eliminated after the interviews.
